title: Stress-Tagged Vice Trigger Map
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log trigger=*
| stats count as events, avg(craving_score) as avg_craving by trigger
| sort - events
description: Ranks the triggers and contexts most often associated with smoking, vaping, drinking, or other vices.
value: Knowing the trigger pattern turns a vague bad habit into something you can actually reroute.
implementation: Tag vice events with trigger categories in `index=personal`; summarize event count and average craving by trigger.
visualization: Bar chart of vice triggers ranked by frequency.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which situations most often set off the habit, so you can plan around the trigger instead of only reacting later.
